structured.approach: I read both contracted inputs (feat.tasks and feat.design) to find which Data Science tasks (TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast) and which data or storage changes the design calls for. Then I checked the ap_forecast checkout myself: I listed its files and searched for database client and migration terms. Finally I wrote task.db_changes, which records that the list of required database changes is empty, with evidence for each point. I used no connectors or subagents, because the inputs, the tool view and the repository already answer the question.

claims.text: The Data Science lane has two tasks in ap_forecast: TSK-03 (STORY-03, risk.vendor_risk) and TSK-04 (STORY-04, build_explanation_request with risk=None).
The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope. Data in this feature stays in memory or travels as CT-1 JSON.
DD-1 adds no new repository, service, runtime, library or storage, and NF-10 requires every new function to be pure and in-memory with no I/O.
TSK-03 makes no LLM call, makes no network call and does not read models.json. TSK-04 must not change models.json.
Any storage or network call from the libraries would re-trigger DES-01, and this design triggers none of them.
ap_forecast has no database. No migrations exist and none are required.
src/ap_forecast contains only __init__.py, explain.py, predict.py and models.json. It has no migration directory or SQL file, and a search for database client and migration terms found nothing.

structured.summary: DS-03 for FEAT-ZD-48600: TSK-03 and TSK-04 in ap_forecast don't need any database changes, so none are left to do. The design puts storage and migrations out of scope (A1, DD-1, NF-10), and ap_forecast has no database or migrations (tool view, confirmed by the file listing and search). task.db_changes records the evidence and an empty change list. There are no open questions.
